description: iSharing is a family locator and GPS location tracker designed to help families stay connected and safe. Share real-time family locations, get alerts when kids or family arrive at or leave important places, and use iSharing as a phone tracker to help find a lost phone. Whether you're checking that your kids arrived safely, keeping track of family throughout the day, or meeting up with a group, iSharing makes everyday location sharing simple. iSharing has been providing location-sharing services since 2010. FEATURES WE OFFER: ★ Real-Time GPS Location Tracker: Privately share real-time locations with family and check family location on the map. Stay connected throughout the day with accurate location updates. ★ Place Alerts & Family Notifications: Get notifications when kids or family arrive at or leave important places such as home, school, or work. Stay informed automatically without repeated check-ins. ★ Meetup - Temporary Group Location Sharing: Share real-time locations and use group chat for a limited time without creating permanent connections. Join with a QR code or link, and location sharing automatically ends when the Meetup is over. ★ Find My Phone & Phone Tracker: Use iSharing to help locate a lost or stolen phone and follow its location on the map. ★ Panic Alert: Send a Panic Alert in an emergency to quickly share your location and send an SOS notification to family. ★ Walkie-Talkie: Send voice messages directly through iSharing for quick and convenient family communication. PREMIUM FEATURES: 🔄 365-Day Location History: Review past locations for up to 365 days 📍 Unlimited Place Alerts: Get arrival and departure alerts for more places 📡 3D Street View: Explore locations with a closer street-level view 🔋 Low Battery Alerts: Know when a family device battery is running low 🚗 Driving Reports & Driving Safety: Review trips, speeding, hard braking, and phone use while driving 🆘 SOS Sound Recording: Receive surrounding audio with SOS alerts 👵 Inactivity Alerts: Get notified when unusual inactivity is detected 💻 Linked Devices & Web App: Access iSharing across supported devices 🛑 Remove Ads: Use iSharing without ads iSharing uses a foreground service to continuously update location in the background, helping provide accurate and timely location updates. Need help? Contact iSharing's support team at contact@isharingsoft.com. * iSharing is designed for mutual location sharing and should only be used with consent.
summary: GPS Phone Tracker: Share live location to find kids & use as a family locator!
